posts.title: the great mystery of purpose - a lanterns review
posts.description: Purpose is a mysterious thing. The whole point of life is simply to live, but most of the time, we are pressured by the world to chase something. To me, the ring in Lanterns represents more than power. It could be status, wealth, a job title, or whatever we are chasing because we think having it will make us feel worthy.
